Also, consistent worker training and supervisory verification are essential to reduce the likelihood of human error. Focusing on worker and facility safety through the development of proper defueling, refueling, ventilation, and verification-based training programs and other interventions can help address the specific needs of hydrogen rail maintenance safety.
